item.text: {"facts":[{"source_id":"SRC-9ed47823df1c3730","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch states that the DRC’s internal conflicts and poor governance contributed to a severe food crisis and the internal displacement of 5.8 million people, while more than 100 armed groups operated in eastern Congo.","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.7","3B.10","6B.6","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The country-page summary does not provide a precise observation date; it describes conditions relevant to the period surrounding the 2023 elections rather than establishing a 2023-only measurement.","ruler_attribution":"The assessment concerns conditions during Félix Tshisekedi’s administration but does not attribute all underlying conflict or displacement directly to him.","limitations":["No quantitative 2023 year-end breakdown or causal attribution to presidential decisions is supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9ed47823df1c3730","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch states that martial law in North Kivu and Ituri facilitated abuses by government security forces, including massacres, abductions, rape and sexual violence, child recruitment, and other attacks on civilians, with near-total impunity.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.5","3B.7","3B.9","3B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The summary lacks a precise date and should be treated as a contextual assessment spanning the administration’s pre-2023-election period, not as a verified 2023-only finding.","ruler_attribution":"The source links the abuses to government security forces and states that martial law facilitated them; it does not identify a specific presidential order or establish Félix Tshisekedi’s personal knowledge or intent.","limitations":["No specific cases, dates, disciplinary actions, or remedy measures are provided in this unit."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9ed47823df1c3730","start_unit":15,"end_unit":15,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch states that freedom of expression, peaceful assembly, and the media were frequently under attack, and that Félix Tshisekedi’s administration had not yet demonstrated systemic reforms and human-rights improvements ahead of the 2023 elections.","question_ids":["3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The wording explicitly references the period ahead of the 2023 elections, but the page does not give a publication date for this assessment or isolate developments within calendar year 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source directly evaluates Tshisekedi’s administration but provides no specific incident or reform measure in this unit.","limitations":["This is an institutional assessment rather than a dated event or quantitative finding."]},{"source_id":"SRC-9ed47823df1c3730","start_unit":17,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch reported that Congolese army units had supported the NDC-R armed group, despite the group’s alleged killings, rape, extortion, and child recruitment; army networks allegedly supplied fighters with guns, ammunition, and equipment, while fighters imposed illegal taxes and forced civilians into hard labor.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.9","3B.2","3B.6","3B.7","7B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The excerpt refers to a 2019 arrest order and says the support occurred “until recently,” but does not establish that the conduct occurred specifically during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The evidence concerns Congolese army units and networks; it does not demonstrate that Tshisekedi personally authorized, knew of, or benefited from the support.","limitations":["The excerpt does not provide precise dates for the alleged support, identify responsible officers by name, or report a completed investigation or disciplinary outcome."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":[],"batch_limitations":["The supplied source is a current Human Rights Watch country page containing mixed-date material; most claims cannot be verified as specific to calendar year 2023.","No supplied unit contains a material fact about nuclear risk, arms control, proliferation safeguards, or catastrophic dual-use governance.","The source provides limited evidence about economic management, social-service administration, personal integrity, or implementation mechanics beyond broad governance assessments."]}
